# JavaScript Clipper 6.4.2.2

Upstream: https://github.com/junmer/clipper-lib/blob/master/clipper.js
Author: Angus Johnson; JavaScript port by Timo. Boost Software License 1.0.
Includes Tom Wu JSBN code; its copyright/license notice is supplied separately.

Local changes: wrap as an ES module without browser-global exports; use the
portable arithmetic selection in both Node and browsers; throw Error instead of
calling alert. Trailing whitespace is normalized. Algorithm and copyright headers are retained.
